title: Quasi-coherent cohomology vanishes above the dimension of a Noetherian scheme
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme] (a quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme], locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth]), let $\mathcal F$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent], and let $q\geq0$ be strictly larger than the topological Krull dimension of $X$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Then the Zariski sheaf cohomology group $H^q(X,\mathcal F)$ [def-sc-zariski-site], [pqf-def-cohomology] is zero. The assertion also includes $X=\varnothing$, whose topological dimension is $-\infty$.

source.place: Proposition 02UZ (cohomology-proposition-vanishing-Noetherian), applied to the underlying Noetherian topological space and the abelian sheaf of a quasi-coherent module

proof.text: Suppose $X$ is nonempty. By [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-scheme-closed-subsets-minimal], its underlying topological space is Noetherian (Stacks 01OZ). Since its topological Krull dimension is strictly below the finite integer $q$, it is a finite integer $d<q$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Apply [lem-sc-zariski-dimension-bound] to the underlying abelian sheaf $\mathcal F_{\mathrm{ab}}$: that node covers every abelian sheaf on the Zariski site of a Noetherian scheme of finite dimension, so $H^q(X,\mathcal F_{\mathrm{ab}})=0$. The canonical comparison [lem-sc-module-abelian-zariski-cohomology] identifies this group with the module cohomology $H^q(X,\mathcal F)$ in the statement. Neither the dimension bound nor the comparison needs quasi-coherence.

source.place: Proposition Tag 02UZ (proposition-vanishing-Noetherian), statement; Properties, Lemma Tag 01OZ (lemma-Noetherian-topology); Sites and Sheaves, Lemma Tag 03FD (lemma-cohomology-modules-abelian-agree)

proof.text: Suppose $X=\varnothing$. Its only open is $\varnothing$; the empty-cover sheaf axiom forces the abelian group of sections $\mathcal F_{\mathrm{ab}}(\varnothing)$ to be zero. Every restriction map is therefore surjective, so $\mathcal F_{\mathrm{ab}}$ is flasque [def-sc-zariski-flasque]. Its $H^0$ is its zero group of global sections, and its $H^q$ is zero for $q>0$ by [lem-sc-zariski-flasque-acyclic]. The comparison [lem-sc-module-abelian-zariski-cohomology] transfers this to the module cohomology, including $q=0$. This covers the $-\infty$ dimension case in [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension].
